title: Build UI CRUD and wire to API
description: Implement complete single-page React UI with note list, view detail, create form, edit inline/modal, delete confirmation, connected to Express API.
steps: Create src/api.ts helper functions using fetch (/api/notes: getAll, getById, create, update, deleteNote)
Build NoteList component: display list of notes with title, preview content, updated timestamp
Build NoteForm component: controlled inputs for title & content, submit handler for create & edit
Build NoteDetail / Action buttons: edit mode toggle, delete button with confirmation
Assemble App.tsx with state: notes list, active editing note, loading & error states
Verify build passes without TypeScript or lint errors
acceptance_criteria: UI loads list of notes from API (or shows empty state)
Can create, edit, delete notes via UI and changes persist to API
